result.markdown:
If you're running a small business in the UK, my recommendation would be **Xero or QuickBooks**\. Both are excellent, but the best choice depends on the type of business you operate and how much accounting you want to do yourself.

I've compared the leading options for 2026.

## Best accounting software for small businesses

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

(Best overall)

**1\. Xero**

Excellent all-round accounting software. Good for growing businesses, bank reconciliation, invoicing, VAT and working with your accountant.

From approximately £7/month + VAT

[Visit Xero](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![Quickbooks Online — Columbus Business Consulting](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/z_-lMr1rk7nVCnHpykvHbFlLn1azsDdLq1E5IPLLHaY_8oSNYyauUS0LtpVtMtsr7aGmH36ThTapoKB2Ph5Q3eMVc_UXwvW966z4ZTJF_6xHgqWw4BiwFU5MO1xbGE5oY_mXKemXduz1fPiAwGEyT1jt_IjAl-f9situ1bcy769twmRe-HD-uB1wI8CWqiLV?purpose=fullsize)

(Best for ease of use)

**2\. QuickBooks**

Great for everyday bookkeeping, tracking expenses, creating invoices, bank feeds and financial reporting.

Entry plans from approximately £10/month + VAT

[Visit QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/)

---

![Sage Group | Company Overview & News](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/VFRaM7Mi6n-B6kypx5NEbH6uZ7gv6tyckO56Q4NaZ2LIxfSUsJX7-BpQgCEEs8eZ1yCTkoB51T4Vi6uho9n0Uh-lEm2VXgC1WYeJjEoJCLFmEjEBjRNPbTFFtsAcn4mH6vl8NHzKL61NACimMLcmOKip1T__uRJNPku-4fp2J-5qEQ-yptJXrboOZoUqd8Yu?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Sage Accounting**

Particularly good for established businesses, VAT, financial reporting and businesses that need payroll integration.

Paid plans available at different levels

[Visit Sage](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/)

---

![FreeAgent Logo PNG Vector (SVG) Free Download](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/4EW4hBD2EUDKpZ5vzXzleX_ZpFL7ewSrW-W7Xzirz-jzVn6P3X95jL6dKI2NWPTYUy9gNZv7yOizFlm19yyMsc2dO__uQrEAzf73EFerzDjWn8HeIwfhoQHLcLNQK7oPAsV7vFV9IfXwDWOGVcvob8QVbUIX7mb0cBSFqkVD_V3B8B9oQ_iqGrd2TgWEshaA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. FreeAgent**

Excellent for sole traders, freelancers and small limited companies. Particularly attractive if you bank with an eligible NatWest, RBS, Ulster Bank or Mettle account.

Free with qualifying bank accounts

[Visit FreeAgent](https://www.freeagent.com/)

---

!["Best 10 Zoho Apps for Small Businesses in 2024 - Must-Have Tools" | C3 Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QMBJut4kUVy6UNtA0DcEcpSKElNdEgHfabBOoR3AWTMUo6phHjAJ01KBTRk_iU44CUuVy6AD0OeM48UFtluYC3mtudqFVjYFesk47WQPcQQfsgxz1-Ctp0z-lODm5vgYFvDQ7IEjwcEwqAsNX1booH4Twqog2tqxnwaLYmRuRR9TviU8hG6khxNJKfVoO6Q2?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Books**

Very good value, with invoicing, expense management, automation and accounting features. Particularly useful if you already use other Zoho products.

Free plan available, subject to eligibility and limits

[Visit Zoho Books](https://www.zoho.com/uk/books/)

## My recommendation

| If your business is... | I'd choose |
|--------|--------|
| Small limited company | Xero |
| Sole trader | QuickBooks or FreeAgent |
| Retail or selling products | Xero |
| Tradesperson or contractor | QuickBooks |
| Growing business with employees | Xero or Sage |
| On a tight budget | Zoho Books |
